title: NES
description: NES games on the iDrive (FCEUmm emulator). Comes with two small free games, Snake and Pad Test. Your own .nes files are copied to the head unit, or read from a folder "nes" on a USB stick (experimental). Main menu with the games and all settings; the game pixel for pixel on the whole screen, on the controller and touch buttons; BACK returns to the menu and saves. No sound
